trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in this guide - story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup - and the platinum is the last pop. Budget around 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 - it is one of the first missions of the game - and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Nothing to prepare; just follow the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Complete every main mission in the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) - it is the run's one missable moment.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter - GTA VI has no mission replay, so chapter saves are your only way back. Both Jason and Lucia are playable from this chapter, which opens up most of the side content.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Robbery-related trophies start unlocking in Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye on the robbery and heist content as the story opens it up.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. By now the full map and most activities are open; use the lull before the finale to start stranger mission chains, since some may have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the final mission. Make a manual save before it - there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a pre-finale save is the only way to revisit the ending. After the credits you return to free roam and the 100% checklist unlocks.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it appears in the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end. No special requirements - just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete The Cartel Heist mission in the story. Heist missions are story-gated, so this one arrives on the main path; there is no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the Child's Play mission when the story brings it up. It pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the Headliners mission in the story. Like the other mission trophies, it cannot be missed - it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the VCIA Takedown mission in the story. The airport area (VCIA) also matters for the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, so learn the layout while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission in the story. It is a late-story mission; the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the 35-item checklist. It is lenient - roughly 60% true completion: required in full are all robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all drone races and Bret's quests; the rest is partial (70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied). Nothing on the checklist is missable - everything can be finished in free roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts come in four kinds - stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps - and there are 397 in total (130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps). The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250; the trophy pops first.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once. Work through the activity list - races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation and the rest - doing each at least one time. It pops when the last untried activity type is sampled; use the in-game activity list to find what you have not touched yet.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges - 18 at the Griffin range and 24 at Rodgers Ranch. Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk first. Gold needs a clean, accurate run on each challenge; take the ranges one at a time. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. There are 42 drone time trials in total - three per location; beat par in the first two to unlock the third, which you only need to finish. The race win at every location is the trophy; the trials feed 100% completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are marked by blue icons on the map; there are 40 unique races in total, and the 100% checklist wants 30 wins. Win any 20 - different races, not the same one repeated.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him - the challenge is a head-to-head, so focus on landing the bigger catch. Fishing is one of the activities that also counts toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end. Starting all four video games counts toward 100% completion, but this trophy only needs one finished.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand is one of the stranger/character quest lines - follow his missions to their conclusion and the trophy pops at the final one. Start character strands as soon as they unlock: some may have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is the treasure-diving quest line around Key Lento, tied to the shipwreck sets and underwater discoveries. Finish his missions and the trophy pops at the last one; the diving also feeds 100% (33 underwater discoveries, 5 of 7 Kenton sets).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when the final mission completes. Like the other character strands, it is not part of 100% completion, but it is needed for the platinum.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions for one character. Stranger missions are not part of 100% completion, but this trophy needs 8 finished strands. Start them as they unlock - some chains may have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its conclusion; the trophy pops at the final mission. Randy is one of the six named character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) behind the strand trophies.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when the final mission completes.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy - the only one every launch guide flags. Meditate at all 18 spots: there are 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia counts each spot twice. The catch is Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning - she says she is going to meditate, heads to the balcony of Jason's house, and you follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1 and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For 100% completion only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, but the trophy wants all 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are the hunting strand - track and take down the unique animal he asks for. Studying animals through binoculars (100 of 255 for 100%) helps you learn the hunting grounds.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 480 cards across 18 sets; finish any 3 sets for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy - the same cards count for both.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with WAiNK while on foot. Scan as you travel - the app is also how you log the 200 of 277 base-model vehicles the 100% checklist wants, so make scanning a habit from the start.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10. Any 50 count for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 70, so leave the hardest 10 for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear - the trophy pops when you escape. Easiest in the countryside, away from patrols.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run while keeping the heat on - do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. Pick three shops close together and move fast.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count as discovered when you first drive or encounter them - vary what you drive and explore different areas, since vehicle types are spread across the map. The WAiNK scan of 200 of 277 base-model vehicles (for 100%) overlaps heavily, so scan as you go.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five of them before the effect ends. Pick a busy firefight - gang operations and robberies give you the densest targets.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA - steal a plane from Vice City International Airport and take off. Head to the airport, get to a plane on the tarmac and fly out; expect a wanted level on the way in, so go in fast and take off quickly.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos - get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank. Tanks appear at military areas and at high wanted levels; steal one and take it for a drive. The trophy is about the tank, so once you are driving a Rhino you are most of the way there.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave without tripping an alarm or being spotted. Stealth gear and a quiet approach matter more than speed here.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are part of the robbery content that opens in Chapters 3 and 4. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so plan for eight - the trophy pops at five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away clean. Trucks follow routes around the city - scout one, then hit it and lose the heat.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the map until the whole state is revealed. Drive, fly and boat across the map - the far corners (Keys, swamps, northern Leonida) are the ones most players leave until last. Exploration also feeds the WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Gang operations are the 39 robbery sites tied to the gangs; hit at least one operation for every gang in the state. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method was published at launch - the description points to a specific Ocean Beach bar spot, so head to the beachfront bars and look for the cocktail interaction with the ocean view. Treat this one as unconfirmed until a guide verifies the exact spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed unlock method was published at launch - the description suggests driving a car through a showroom's front, so find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside or aimed at it, and smash out through the glass. Unconfirmed: the exact showroom and trigger are still being verified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and complete a game - 'follow-through' points to finishing a full game with a proper delivery. Bowling is also one of the activity types for Master of None.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This hidden trophy's unlock method was unconfirmed at launch. The description hints at a partner-related milestone - likely tied to story or side content with Jason and Lucia together - so keep playing the duo content and check the guides as methods are verified. Do not rely on unverified methods.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This hidden trophy's method was unconfirmed at launch. The wording points to a story choice with consequences - make your choices during the story and the trophy should pop at the relevant decision. Keep a save before major choices: there is no mission replay.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed unlock method was published at launch. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something - possibly a failed-then-retried moment - but the exact trigger is unverified. Play on and check the guides as the community pins it down.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method at launch. The name and description suggest a strange encounter or easter egg - explore off the beaten path and watch for the unusual. Do not chase rumoured methods until a trusted guide confirms one.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The precise method was still being confirmed at launch - the description points to knocking enemies down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Try a melee swing from a car or bike at speed; verify against a trusted guide before grinding it.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from banks and payday loan jobs - one large bank can pay up to $205,000. Fence $250,000 through your contacts; the same total is required for 100% completion, so this trophy pops on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, gear and upgrades across Leonida's shops until the total passes $100,000 - spending is cumulative across every shop. It comes naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short late on, buy big-ticket items.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market - check the property listings across Leonida and buy each garage. Properties cost serious money, so build your funds through robberies and fencing first.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them through the Scooter Bros app until ten are logged. Any ten vehicles count - use common ones you find early and often.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
